warmup.description: Activate upper back and shoulders with gentle mobility and light band engagement.

main_exercises.name: Resistance Band Face Pull
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light resistance band, focus on controlled contraction
main_exercises.form_cue: Pull band toward face while keeping elbows high and shoulders down

main_exercises.name: Resistance Band External Rotation
main_exercises.load_guidance: Very light band, prioritize slow and controlled movement
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep elbow pinned to your side and rotate only through the shoulder

main_exercises.name: Wall-Supported Y-T Raises
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight or very light resistance, focus on activation
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep arms long and avoid shrugging shoulders upward

main_exercises.name: Resistance Band Row (Seated or Standing)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light band, focus on scapular retraction rather than load
main_exercises.form_cue: Pull shoulder blades together before bending elbows

main_exercises.name: Scapular Push-Ups
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep arms straight and move only through the shoulder blades

cooldown.description: Release upper body tension and reinforce relaxed, aligned posture.
movements: Chest stretch against wall x 30s each side
Upper trap stretch x 30s each side
Child’s pose with arms extended x 60s

phase_notes.menstrual: This gentle, posture-focused session is ideal—keep movements slow and focus on releasing tension while maintaining light activation.
phase_notes.follicular: Use this session to reinforce strong posture and scapular control—these foundations will support heavier upper body training later.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Even with higher energy, keep the focus on precision and control—this is a great time to refine movement quality.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain consistency and focus on clean execution—this session helps support shoulder health and posture as fatigue may begin to rise.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session is highly supportive—keep movements gentle and controlled, focusing on reducing tension and maintaining alignment.
